This '''bazaar seller''' ran a business in a bazaar on a [[Unidentified planet (Outreachial)|planet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] complained to the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] that the locals kept stealing his [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]]. The merchant told him that the locals were not responsible, but the [[Lizardfly|lizardflies]] who lived in the cliffs above [[Outreachial]].
